text:
Yes, we should be able to deploy to staging today.

All 212 tests are passing. One flaky test failed on its first run and passed on the retry, so I'm not worried about it.

The only thing left is QA sign-off, which should come in by 3 pm. The deploy window closes at 5 pm, so that leaves us enough time once QA approves.

I'll post here as soon as we have sign-off. Let me know if you have other questions.
